title: Q1 2026 Portfolio Review
subtitle: Chen Family Trust — Managed Account Summary

sections.title: Asset Allocation
sections.content: Current allocation: 55% US Equities ($1,566,026), 15% International Equities ($427,098), 20% Fixed Income ($569,464), 5% Real Estate ($142,366), 5% Cash & Equivalents ($142,366). Target allocation unchanged from last quarter. US Equities slightly overweight due to Q1 performance.

sections.title: Performance Attribution
sections.content: Top contributors: Technology sector (+8.2% allocation return), Healthcare (+5.1%), Consumer Discretionary (+4.8%). Detractors: Energy (-2.1%), Utilities (-0.8%). International holdings contributed +3.4% with strength in European markets.

sections.title: Fixed Income Analysis
sections.content: Bond portfolio duration: 4.8 years. Average yield: 4.9%. Holdings split between investment-grade corporate bonds (60%), US Treasuries (25%), and municipal bonds (15%). No credit events during the quarter.

sections.title: Risk Metrics
sections.content: Portfolio beta: 0.87. Sharpe ratio: 1.42 (trailing 12 months). Maximum drawdown in Q1: -1.8% (February). VaR (95%, 1-day): $28,470.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.content: 1. Rebalance US Equities to target 55% (trim $12,400). 2. Increase municipal bond allocation ahead of potential tax law changes. 3. Consider adding emerging market exposure (target 3% from International). 4. Schedule annual estate planning review — trust provisions should be reviewed given new beneficiary.

bulletPoints: Portfolio outperformed benchmark by 40 basis points this quarter
Dividend income on track for $68,420 annually
Tax-loss harvesting captured $14,200 in realized losses
additionalNotes: RMD for 2026 estimated at $42,800 from IRA holdings.
Charitable giving strategy: consider donor-advised fund contribution before year-end.
Account consolidated from 3 prior advisors in 2023.
